root.label: Administration finalizes four-year international student stay rule

events.label: Administration finalizes four-year international student stay rule

slots.name: stay limit
slots.sentence: This summer, the administration finalized a rule that sought to prevent international students from staying in the U.S. for more than four years without approval from the federal government.

slots.name: rule status
slots.sentence: A federal court prevented the rule from taking effect in September.
